original: Knock it off、 Sister Prier! Our job is to investigate the Dark World、 not to test out how strong you are。
contexto:
Dialogue. Adjacent lines in the same event:
It is hard to keep track with her ridiculous power。 If she keeps this up、 she could get injured。 You listening、 Prier?
What do you mean get hurt? I am not planning on losing! I wonder if there are any stronger demons around。。。
I am not hunting demons just for fun、 ya know! I am investigating。 You know、 gathering information。。。 I am figuring out how strong the demons are in this area。
There she goes、 talking down to people again。
